title: Tensor formula for the right adjoint of a perfect proper immersion
statement: Let i:Z\to Y be a closed immersion of Noetherian schemes [def-pc-scheme] that is proper and perfect, where perfect means i_*\mathcal O_Z is locally perfect over Y [def-pc-perfect-complex]. Let c be a right adjoint to Ri_* on quasi-coherent derived categories [def-pc-derived-category], and K a quasi-coherent complex on Y. The canonical comparison morphism Li^*K\mathbin{\otimes^L}c(\mathcal O_Y)\to c(K), defined as the mate under Ri_*\dashv c of the projection-formula morphism Ri_*(Li^*K\mathbin{\otimes^L}c(\mathcal O_Y))\to K, is an isomorphism; equivalently c(K)\cong Li^*K\mathbin{\otimes^L}c(\mathcal O_Y).

source.place: Tag 0A9U (projection formula for a perfect proper morphism and its right adjoint)

proof.text: Use perfectImmersion_stalkwiseTorBounds to obtain the finite Tor bounds in both conventions; apply smoothProper_tensor_perfect_case with the Tor-prime bound. Its existential witnesses supply hRf, hO, hTensor, the monoidal structure, the pullback adjunction, and invertibility of the counit-pinned comparison on all perfect K.

For each specified monoidal structure, pullback adjunction, and right adjoint c, install coproducts on both quasi-coherent derived categories. Apply properPerfect_rightAdjoint_preservesCoproducts with the Tor bound and the canonical liftCompιIso of the quasi-coherent pushforward lift to obtain coproduct preservation of c.

Let P(K) be exactly the existential pf and IsIso predicate in the theorem conclusion. Apply rightAdjointTensorLocus_localizing to obtain its five closure conditions. Combine them with the perfect-case witness to show P is one of the properties in the defining infimum of perfectLocalizingClosure Y. Therefore sInf_le gives perfectLocalizingClosure Y ≤ P.

Rewrite the left hand side using derivedQCohPerfectGeneration Y. The resulting inequality top ≤ P applied to K proves the required existential with exactly the given witnesses and the same counit-pinned comparison.
